description: Case-level review of the income documents of salaried borrowers after preliminary approval. Requested months follow the public Mizrahi-Tefahot checklist (3 latest payslips per salaried borrower); the window and tolerances are configuration, not bank policy.

criteria.title_he: כל החודשים הנדרשים מכוסים בתלוש משלהם

criteria.guidance: Compare like with like (net with net, gross with gross, the same months). An unverified customer explanation is context, never proof. Use INCONSISTENT for a grounded difference, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the definitions or months cannot be compared, CONSISTENT only when the documents support the declaration.

criteria.title_he: כל מסמכי השכר הנדרשים עברו בדיקה תקינה
